content:
Devlens Bangladesh is an independent information and intelligence platform for Bangladesh’s development and humanitarian sector.

We bring news, funding opportunities, jobs, research, data and analysis into one trusted place for NGO and INGO staff, UN and humanitarian professionals, donors, researchers, consultants, journalists, policymakers and students.

What we do

  • Report what is happening across the sector and explain why it matters.
  • List open funding, jobs and learning opportunities with clear deadlines and links to the original notice.
  • Summarise research and evidence so it is easier to find and use.
  • Track data and funding trends over time.
  • Publish ideas and perspectives from people working across the sector.

Our independence

Coverage cannot be bought. NGOs and researchers can send us their news, research and events, and we publish what meets our standards. Sponsored content is always labelled. Read our editorial standards to see how we decide what to publish.

Geographic focus

Bangladesh first, then South Asia and global developments where they directly affect Bangladesh.

Contact and follow

Email us at devlensbangladesh@gmail.com, or use our submission page for story tips, corrections, opportunities and partnership enquiries.

Follow Devlens on Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
